entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Vast ancient forest covering much of Kessig on Innistrad, also called the Misty Wood or Impossible Wood, haunted by werewolves and spirits.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Province of Innistrad isolated by the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane on which the Ulvenwald lies.

entities.name: Vildin Howlpack
entities.description: Werewolf pack known for stalking travelers deep in the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Bower Passage
entities.description: One of the three Breakneck Ride paths, a road from Gavony through the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: Province from which Bower Passage leads.

entities.name: Briarbridge
entities.description: Village by a stream at the forest edge, known for its two creaking waterwheels.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: Large mechanical device hidden in the woods, once used during the Harvesttide festival.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: Festival during which the Celestus was used.

events.summary: Werewolves of the Vildin Howlpack hunt travelers, chasing them in circles through the mist.
events.quote: They often hunt by toying with their prey
